messages:
devon (PM): Heads up — we need to lock scope for the PRD covering generation "cutoff" behaviors, resume-on-retry semantics, and safe retry defaults. Customer asks: predictable partial-output signals (so apps can show a spinner + resume) and a clear contract for how retries affect token accounting.

anika (Eng): Can you summarize the acceptance criteria you need? I can sketch API surface options.

devon (PM): Sure. Minimal ACs: 1) API returns a deterministic "cutoff_reason" when streaming stops early (values: end, truncated_max_tokens, truncated_context, client_cancel). 2) When a retry is attempted within a configurable window, service can supply a resume_token that lets the client request continuation without duplicating paid tokens. 3) Default retry policy should be defensive (no automatic repeated costly retries) and observable.

matt (ML): For resume_token — model side needs to ensure logits/KV cache compatibility. Two options: a) server-side resume (server keeps KV and continues; cheaper client experience but stateful), b) stateless resume_token that encodes prompt suffix + generation seed (brittle across quantization). Prefer server-side for 1st iteration.

sasha (SRE): Server-side state increases memory retention windows. Need limits: max resume window 60s by default, max live resume sessions per model per GPU. Also eviction policy. We'll need telemetry for resume hit/miss rates.

devon (PM): Good notes. Let's capture tradeoffs in the PRD and a recommended path: server-side resume for GA, fallback to full re-generation if state missing.

raj (Support): Customer examples: one enterprise asked for "resume after transient network blip" and to avoid double-charges when UI retries. They want explicit billing semantics documented.

anika (Eng): Proposal for API shape (sketch):
```
POST /v1/generate
{ prompt, max_tokens, stream: true }
-- stream frames include: {type: "delta", text}, {type: "terminal", cutoff_reason, resume_token?}
```
Resume flow: client posts {resume_token, additional_max_tokens}. Server validates token TTL and continues stream. If token expired -> returns {error: "resume_unavailable", recommended_action: "replay_from_last_user_message"}.

matt (ML): Edge case: partial tokens (multibyte) when truncation happens mid-token. We should guarantee that we never cut inside a UTF-8 codepoint; truncate to previous codepoint boundary. Also consider structured outputs: if JSON output gets truncated we should include a "partial_object" flag to help client fall back.

sasha (SRE): Also: when retry leads to model fallback (cheaper variant), ensure we include "model_variant" header in terminal frame so clients can detect potential output drift.

devon (PM): Acceptance criteria draft (short):
- cutoff_reason present for all terminal frames (string enum)
- resume_token issued only for server-side sessions and TTL documented
- resume success preserves non-duplicative billing (tokens already emitted are not billed twice)
- clear error codes for resume_unavailable, token_invalid, token_expired
- metrics: resume_success_rate, resume_latency, resume_evictions, retry_cost_delta

anika (Eng): Implementation notes: maintain per-request metadata map keyed by resume_id. Keep replay logs for audit, TTL default 30s (per sasha suggestion 60s earlier — we should pick one). I vote 45s default to balance.

sasha (SRE): 45s is OK. We'll also require a global cap: 10k concurrent resume sessions per region initially. We'll include circuit breaker if memory pressure high.

matt (ML): For rollout: canary with model_variant pinned off by default. Start with a small traffic % for server-side resume, monitor for increased OOMs or evictions.

devon (PM): Prioritization ask: customers + risk -> GA target for this initiative as part of Q3 roadmap. Required work items: PRD, API design review, infra quota changes, billing doc, SDK examples. Which of these are blockers for initial beta?

anika (Eng): Beta blockers: API shape agreed, resume storage proto implemented, metrics emitted, SDK quickstart. Billing doc can be post-beta but we need guidance.

sasha (SRE): Infra blocker: quota bump and a feature-flagged resume store. I can provision feature flag and metrics dashboards this week.

raj (Support): I'll draft external-facing billing paragraph once we have final token accounting rules.

devon (PM): Next steps: anika to draft API spec + example frames, matt to write model compatibility checklist, sasha to propose infra limits and dashboard, raj to draft billing blurb. Sync in 48h. @anika @matt @sasha @raj : please ack. :thumbsup:

anika (Eng): ack

matt (ML): ack

sasha (SRE): ack

ops-bot: Reminder: Meeting scheduled in 48 hours: "Gen API cutoff/resume sync" (calendar invite sent).

devon (PM): Thanks everyone — will open PRD doc and link here when ready.
